proposed_widenings.name: species_trait_choice_over_mixed_mechanics_families
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is one authored unit whose core rule is choosing exactly one ancestry boon at build time, but the options span incompatible mechanics families: activation, triggered reaction, and on-hit rider. The current species_trait surface only allows passive or activation, with no top-level choice/composite over heterogeneous mechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following benefits ... you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus

proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.triggered_reaction
proposed_widenings.justification: Two Giant Ancestry options are reaction-shaped species benefits with PB-based uses and long-rest reset, but species traits cannot currently reuse TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Stone's Endurance ... when you take damage, you can take a Reaction ...; Storm's Thunder ... when you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction

proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.on_hit_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Three Giant Ancestry options are attack-hit riders, but the on-hit trigger family is currently reserved to mastery records and cannot be attached to a species trait resource/reset scaffold.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also ...

notes: Did not author content/species_goliath_giant_ancestry.dhall because encoding any single boon would misrepresent the unit, and collapsing the build-time choice into one mechanics family would be false.
